evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $36,000,000; attorneys' fees $7,200,000; clear sailing no;
The class-fund and fee amounts were included together in the proposals; they were not negotiated only after class relief had been agreed.
Whitcombe Reyes LLP’s latest proposal has a $31.25 million total cash outlay, below Brightline’s $40 million cap and lower than Hargrove Lane LLP’s proposal.
Accepting it secures a binding settlement on the lower-cost terms.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening term sheets, and fees were included in proposals before class relief was finalized. The defense selected Whitcombe’s proposal because it was lower than Hargrove’s and within the cap, supporting a reverse-auction label. The transcript does not clearly show class counsel trading class recovery for fees, prioritizing firm economics, or filing a misleading declaration.
